purpose: 从同一维度的一组互斥选项中选择唯一结果。

typography.note: 2026-09-10 之前绑定旧样式 Body_14px_regular（解析为 Microsoft YaHei），设计已在 Figma 改绑为当前字体体系的 中文/S8-CN-R（PingFang SC）。RAD-001 已关闭。

behavior.selection: Selecting one option clears the previous checked option in the same named group.
behavior.stateMapping: Figma raw property value "mouseon" is the keyboard focus-visible halo; the Skill's local state key is renamed to "focus" (2026-09-08 设计确认，见 RAD-004) to avoid being read as a pointer/mouse state — code binds it to :focus-visible, kept as a visually distinct 20px halo from :hover so keyboard users retain an independent, high-visibility focus indicator. Figma mousedown is a transient press-moment animation (see RAD-003), not a persisted style, and settles into the pressed option's resulting checked/unchecked appearance on release.

constraints: Exactly one option may be checked per group.
Preselect only a safe or explicitly recommended value.
Use Selector when options are numerous or space is insufficient.
2026-09-10：Figma 已将 5 个纵向 Group variant 的属性值由 verticle 修正为 vertical（节点 2982:4176，见 RAD-002）；mapping.json 暂保留 verticle→vertical 的兼容归一化，以兼容历史缓存/未刷新的实例。
RAD-004 已部分关闭（2026-09-08 设计确认）：保留独立的键盘焦点光晕，本地状态名由 mouseon 重命名为 focus；Figma 源属性值本身仍为 mouseon，不作为需要 Figma 侧修改的问题。

confirmedDecisions.decision: 保留 mouseon 对应的键盘焦点 20px 光晕（不与 hover 合并），本地状态名重命名为 focus 以准确表达语义；Figma 源属性值 mouseon 保持不变。

Figma 侧已将 Radiobutton Group 的 5 个纵向 variant 的 align 属性值从 verticle 修正为 vertical（节点 2982:4176：2982:4260/4263/4267/4272/4278，均复查为 align=vertical）。mapping.json 中 align.verticle→vertical 的兼容归一化暂保留，作为历史兼容层。
